prose: The Financial Times reports Anthropic has disclosed roughly $900 billion in AI spending commitments ahead of its IPO - the purchase commitments and lease agreements detailed in the amended S-1, substantially all tied to compute and infrastructure. The figure reframes the listing: investors are being asked to price not just the fastest-growing software business ever, but one of the largest infrastructure obligations in corporate history.
highlights: FT puts Anthropic's spending commitments at ~$900B ahead of the IPO
The commitments are nearly all compute and infrastructure, per the amended S-1
basis: Cache status: error (FT paywall); summary written from the feed headline and the public S-1 figures it reports on.
